priority_justification: Critical cloud application vulnerability remains open past its target date and a high-severity vulnerability lacks a deadline
Three sampled accounts lack MFA enforcement and the undocumented exception requires investigation
Failed and missed restoration tests create uncertainty about the ability to recover critical business services
Missing device ownership and security settings increase the risk of unmanaged or unprotected company equipment
Incident exercises were incomplete and notification responsibilities have not been adequately tested
Missing formal approvals and review records weaken accountability and ongoing security oversight
Overdue and unassigned training may leave employees less prepared to recognize security threats
